How It Works

Channels multiply; strategy should not fragment

Most businesses do not have a traffic problem — they have a coordination problem. SEO says one thing, ads chase another, the website converts neither.

Our digital marketing service unifies the channels under one strategy: organic search builds the foundation, content compounds it, paid media accelerates what already converts, and every channel reports into the same revenue dashboard.

FAQs

FAQs on digital marketing services

Do we need every channel?

No — the audit recommends the mix your market and budget justify; most clients start with SEO plus one accelerator.

How is budget split decided?

By expected return per channel, reviewed monthly as real conversion data arrives.

Can you work with our existing PPC agency?

Yes — we coordinate strategy and share keyword data so channels stop competing with each other.

What reporting do we see?

One dashboard: spend, sessions, leads and revenue by channel, plus a monthly review call.

Can we start with one channel and expand?

Yes — most clients start with SEO plus one accelerator. The strategy is built so channels can be added without re-planning from scratch.

Who owns the accounts and data?

You do. Ad accounts, analytics and dashboards are set up under your ownership from day one.
